face_front: frontal face photo, neutral expression - IDENTITY
face_34_right: three-quarter view, nose pointing toward image-right - IDENTITY
face_34_left: three-quarter view, nose pointing toward image-left - IDENTITY
face_profile_right: near-profile, nose pointing at image-right - IDENTITY: nose bridge, jaw, ear
face_profile_left: near-profile, nose pointing at image-left - IDENTITY: nose profile, chin
face_back34: back-three-quarter view showing hair length and how it falls
face_angles: board of several real photos of the head from different angles - IDENTITY from all angles
body_front: full-body video frame, front view - BODY proportions and posture only (ignore clothing)
body_back: full-body video frame, back view - BODY and any back/arm marks
body_turn: strip of full-body video frames: front, right side, left side, back - BODY proportions and marks only (ignore clothing)
emo_core: board of six REAL frames from the person's emotion video, labelled in the prompt by what each face shows
emo_speaking: board of six REAL frames of the person talking to camera
passport_portrait: the APPROVED generated passport portrait - target look (hair, white T-shirt, studio light) and identity
